concerns.text: The plan’s core scientific premise assumes that a probabilistic record linkage between AGP and HRS will yield ≥ 200 linked participants, yet the research document explicitly states that public releases have zero overlapping participant IDs. Relying on demographic matching to fabricate links is methodologically invalid and makes the downstream correlation and modeling analyses unsound.

concerns.location: research.md:2.3 Linkage Feasibility – overlap will be 0, pipeline aborts
concerns.text: The research section acknowledges a “Fatal Coverage Gap” (zero overlap) and aborts the pipeline, but the specification still lists downstream tasks (correlation, modeling, power analysis) as required. This creates a circular situation where the validation (correlation) depends on a dataset that the plan itself declares impossible to obtain.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 1 – Probabilistic Record Linkage & Age Filter (Task T002)
concerns.text: Using the same demographic variables (age, sex, BMI, education) for probabilistic linkage and later as covariates in adjustment introduces leakage and bias. The validation target (cognitive_score) is not independent of the predictors because the linkage step conditions on the very covariates that will be controlled for, violating the independence requirement for a valid associational analysis.
